mission_title: Inter-Sprint catalogue search and internal commercial pricing preview
phase: Complete. Central pricing layer, PFU component, customer/internal projection boundary, catalogue search and the internal admin preview all exist and are tested. No supplier cost data exists to price against.

source_authority.deldo: API documentation.pdf and 26933TEST.csv, supplied by Jan Van Dyck (Deldo NV), subject 'RE: Connect platform and orders for - 026933 (Go Rush Trasporti srl)'. Both inspected directly in this session. GoRush customer number 026933.
source_authority.note: The PDF does NOT document the CSV columns ('we send you 1 file in CSV format so that you can examine file header and structure'). The sample file IS the column contract, and every mapping was read off it.
source_authority.deldo_reverified: Both primary artefacts were re-read independently on 2026-09-22 and every PRIMARY claim in docs/suppliers/deldo/README.md was re-derived from them: 26933TEST.csv (1,322,596 bytes, sha256 5e384ccf45d06ec3..., 6,729 data rows, 35 columns, ';' delimited, no quoting, POINT decimal separator on 6729/6729 Price values, pure ASCII, LF endings, 0 malformed rows) and API documentation.pdf (18 pages). The existing parser and GET_STOCK client were confirmed to match these artefacts.

completed: M7: central GommaRush pricing layer in src/lib/pricing/, deliberately OUTSIDE any supplier adapter. settings.ts holds markup 20% (provenance POLICY_OWNER), optional minimum profit, VAT 22% (STATUTORY) and pfuVatBase='unresolved'; every figure carries a provenance marker and an UNRESOLVED one is refused, not defaulted. pfu.ts implements SUPPLIER_EXACT/RULE_CALCULATED/MANUAL_CONFIRMED/TO_CONFIRM with an EMPTY verified-tariff table and refuses to derive an amount from weight. calculate.ts computes cost -> markup -> net -> PFU -> taxable -> VAT -> total in integer cents, failing closed at three points. projection.ts makes the customer/internal split two DIFFERENT TYPES so a supplier cost has nowhere to sit in a customer payload. catalogue-search.ts searches the existing normalized catalogue (no parallel catalogue) by width/aspect/rim/season. Internal preview at /admin/catalogue/ricerca, admin-guarded by the (secure) layout AND re-checked in the route. 56 new tests.

M6: runtime data-classification guard at the Deldo import boundary (assertDataClassification / assertFeedCommercialMode in observation.ts); classification re-asserted and surfaced explicitly on DeldoListingPersistencePlan as dataClassification/commercialMode/observationSource; 24 new tests; Quality=season and Vehicle=vehicle-class locked by regression tests.

M5: reconciled the docs/suppliers provenance system with the existing Deldo implementation; corrected two factual errors; closed the lane-freshness test gap; recorded PRIMARY/SECOND-HAND/UNCONFIRMED provenance in docs/suppliers/deldo/README.md.

DOCUMENTATION ONLY. Recorded the approved commercial architecture decisions in docs/architecture/04_SALES_SOURCING_MODEL.md: supplier identity invisible to customers; customer buys only from GommaRush; standard up to ~7 days vs express ~24-48h manually sourced from the Italian supplier; the 15-20% express share recorded explicitly as a planning assumption and not a rule; supplier minimum quantities and consolidation supported internally; customer order acceptance and supplier purchase/release as separate events; many customer orders per supplier batch; delivery promises must account for consolidation and cut-off rather than raw supplier availability; normal/older-DOT/Demo kept distinguishable; older-DOT offerable as a clearly identified cheaper GommaRush option; supplied DOT year preserved; Deldo Demo meaning unverified and not to be inferred; exact supplier listing/article survives sourcing and ordering; V1 payments bank transfer, POS on delivery, cash; manual review of every customer order; customer-specific pricing supported architecturally; portal and WhatsApp on one catalogue/pricing/order engine.
Added Deldo activation question 8 (what does the Demo column mean), noting explicitly that no DOT-encoding question is needed because the feed already supplies the year.

tests.npm test: 677 passed / 4 skipped (46 files, 1 skipped file). Up from 621: +56 tests (32 pricing calculation, 13 projection boundary, 11 catalogue search).
tests.npm run lint: 0 errors, 7 warnings - all pre-existing UI warnings (HeroBackground, DriverHome x2, SummaryDashboard, VehicleBoard, BrandMarquee, Hero). None in pricing, search or the new preview.
tests.verify-migration-baseline.sh: NOT RE-RUN this mission - no migration, schema or baseline file was touched.

production_changes: NONE. Production was READ ONLY this mission: SELECT-only introspection to establish what commercial data exists.
database_changes: NONE. No migration was written, applied or planned. M7 reads the existing catalogue schema unchanged.
external_actions: NONE. No supplier API call, no supplier contact, no order.
blockers: M7 BLOCKER - NO SUPPLIER COST DATA. All 9,559 rows in supplier_listing_prices have purchase_price NULL and stock NULL (verified in production 2026-09-22). The single catalogue import run, GommaRush_ISB_Tyre_Catalogue_Import-3.xlsx (adapter 'isb', 9,559 rows, committed 2026-09-08), was SPECIFICATION ONLY. Every listing therefore prices as 'cost_unavailable'. The pricing engine is complete and tested; it has nothing to price. Resolving this needs a price-bearing Inter-Sprint file, which is a supplier/commercial action, not an engineering one.
M7 BLOCKER - PFU. No verified tariff exists, so every listing resolves to TO_CONFIRM and no customer total is produced. VERIFIED_PFU_TARIFFS is deliberately empty. Blocked on D3.
M7 BLOCKER - PFU/VAT base. pfuVatBase is 'unresolved' pending the commercialista, which independently blocks the customer total even once a tariff exists.

Deldo persistence is gated by the schema reconciliation. persistDeldoImport throws DeldoPersistenceUnavailableError by design and must stay closed until 0001_deldo_classification.sql is deliberately applied.
No Deldo feed can be fetched: no FTP credentials, and SFTP/FTPS support is unconfirmed.
No GET_STOCK test token has been issued, so the API path has never executed against Deldo.
risks: M7: the catalogue's only supplier record is literally named 'asdas' (R4/D1). The DB therefore cannot confirm this catalogue IS Inter-Sprint; the evidence is the import run's adapter tag 'isb'. The internal preview shows that supplier name verbatim rather than relabelling it, because renaming a supplier on a hunch is exactly the silent conflict resolution CLAUDE.md forbids.

M7: the catalogue schema has NO EU-label columns beyond eprel_id (no fuel efficiency, wet grip or noise). 8,972 of 9,550 active products carry an eprel_id. The preview surfaces that id and nothing more; the richer label data is simply not in the system and must not be inferred from it.

M7: availability is projected as unknown/in_stock/on_request, never as a quantity. ISB ships thresholds ('>20') and the Deldo sample is banded 3..100, so neither is a count a customer promise could rest on. Today every row reads 'unknown' because no stock is stored at all.

M7: the preview is INTERNAL ONLY and deliberately has no public counterpart. The customer projection exists and is tested but nothing serves it yet. The first route that does must use toCustomerOffer, never toInternalOffer.

buildDeldoImport currently has NO non-test caller: there is no admin route, upload route or server action that reaches Deldo import. So there was no live bypass to close. The runtime guard was added because the FIRST such route - the next mission is feed activation - would otherwise pass unvalidated JSON straight through an erased TypeScript type.

guardKnownTestFile only recognises the one named file 26933TEST.csv. It is a deliberate backstop, not a heuristic, and must not be broadened into 'looks like test data' - such a guess would eventually be wrong in the expensive direction.

CORRECTED: a prior session working on the unrelated branch claude/sleepy-gauss-lezg26 concluded that no Deldo parser could be written because the primary files had never been inspected. That was wrong. The parser exists, is grounded in 26933TEST.csv, and is tested. That branch diverged from d6e2cda and never contained any of this Deldo work; it duplicated the schema baseline independently. Do not merge it over this branch.

Discount range was misstated as '-407.69 to +63.23' in both src/lib/suppliers/deldo/feed/parse.ts and docs/DELDO_ACTIVATION.md. The true range across 3,639 non-zero values is -407.69 to +78.33; 644 rows exceeded the stated upper bound. Both corrected. The conclusion drawn from it - never apply Discount - was and remains correct.

Stock in 26933TEST.csv has a hard floor of 3 and a hard ceiling of 100 (464 rows at exactly 100, none above, no zero-stock rows). That looks like deliberate banding rather than true counts, so it must not be presented as an exact quantity until Deldo confirms the semantics.

risks.summary: Production's function bodies were not created from the repository's migrations: 12 of 28 have their comments stripped and differ in formatting, though all 28 are semantically identical.
risks.impact: Evidence that functions too were applied outside version control. No behavioural difference exists today, but the same practice produced R15.
risks.resolution: The baseline carries the repository's commented versions. Requiring all schema change to go through migrations, enforced by the verify script in CI, is the fix.

risks.summary: RESOLVED IN SOURCE, NOT YET IN THE LEDGER. The 14 tables that no migration created are now in supabase/baseline/, proved to rebuild from empty. What remains is reconciling production's migration ledger, which needs a backup and approval (B9).
risks.impact: Until the ledger is reconciled, `supabase db push` against production is still unpredictable. The schema itself is no longer at risk of being lost.

risks.summary: Production changes were historically applied outside the migration system. A captured baseline fixes the past but not the practice.
risks.impact: Without a rule and a check, the divergence recurs and the next baseline is needed in months.
risks.resolution: scripts/verify-migration-baseline.sh is now CI-suitable and asserts every object count. Wiring it into CI closes this.

risks.summary: Deldo documentation conflicts with itself on the GET_STOCK request parameter. The 'URL Parameters' section lists productId=[integer|string] OR ean=[string]; both worked examples use article=.
risks.impact: A wrong parameter name means every live lookup fails, or worse, silently returns nothing useful.
risks.resolution: article= is implemented because it is the only form demonstrated. Confirm with Deldo when requesting the token - it costs one line in the same email as B5.

risks.summary: The Discount column's meaning is undocumented and values range from -407.69 to +78.33. A plain percentage discount cannot be negative.
risks.impact: If Discount must be applied to reach the real purchase price, every Deldo cost is currently wrong. If it must not, applying it later would corrupt every margin.
risks.resolution: Carried verbatim and never applied. purchasePrice is the Price column as supplied. Needs D7.

risks.summary: Which of Deldo's two documented pricing modes GoRush receives is not stated anywhere - tyre price with transport separate, or transport included for a destination country.
risks.impact: The same number means different things under each. A markup applied to the wrong interpretation misprices every Deldo tyre.
risks.resolution: Every observation carries commercialMode 'unknown', which classifyObservation treats as not commercially usable. Needs D8.

risks.summary: Neither the feed nor the API returns a currency.
risks.impact: Deldo is Belgian and EUR is the obvious assumption, but an assumed currency on a purchase price is exactly the class of silent error this integration must not make.
risks.resolution: currency is left null. Needs D8 alongside the pricing mode.

risks.summary: 530 of 6,729 rows are flagged for review: 459 parenthesised or damaged load/speed values, 70 three-digit truck rims, 3 imperial widths.
risks.impact: Descriptive only - no commercial field is affected. These rows import with null dimensions rather than guesses.
risks.resolution: Acceptable. Revisit if search quality suffers.

risks.summary: Carried from M1, unchanged: the Inter-Sprint Gateway Manual conflict. protocols.ts cites Gateway Manual v2.2 with paragraph refs; the sleepy-gauss capability notes assert no verified protocol documentation exists, and the manual is not in this repository.
